variant_meaning.original: The base fictional text for a cluster.
variant_meaning.exact-copy: An exact copy of the cluster original.
variant_meaning.light-edits: A few words changed against the original (near-duplicate).
variant_meaning.paragraph-removed: A paragraph removed from the original (partial overlap).
variant_meaning.paragraph-added: A new paragraph inserted into the original (partial overlap).
variant_meaning.same-theme: Different wording on the same theme, no copied sentences.
variant_meaning.unrelated: Unrelated content used as a below-threshold contrast.
